arm: G1 configuration (C* control, k = 11,541.56, cold, rel 1e-4, rho_pf 300 adaptive, cap 90, budget 5.0e6, ESSO tol 1e-8 / acceptable_tol 1e-7, H3, Candidates 1/2/4/5 as committed) with EPS_ESSO_THROUGHPUT = 1e-5 instead of 1e-3, applied at runtime on the shared_energy_storage_data module before model build. Recovery G1-equivalent (case33_1 ineligible, tier 2 off) so that epsilon is the only change.

criterion.always_report: per-node EFC/day and relative distance to old; EFC gap closure vs G1; detector range and ratio to G1; recourse vs G1 and old with rule-nine bars; terminal lg(mu) and s_obj
criterion.decision: H-epsilon SUPPORTED iff efc (all nodes) AND detector; then production eps = 1e-5, ESSO tol = 1e-10, acceptable_tol = 1e-9, G1 re-run as new baseline, then G3-full re-run. NOT SUPPORTED otherwise: record the EFC change as unattributed to Step 1b / epsilon and keep eps = 1e-3.
criterion.detector: supported iff max over cycles >= 1 of the measured detector (min(pch,pdch)/s_max) lies in [0.5, 2] * (100 * g1_detector_max_cycles) = [1.2928e-03, 5.1712e-03]
criterion.efc: supported on node n iff |EFC_C(n) - EFC_old(n)| <= 0.02 * EFC_old(n); required on all three nodes 5, 7, 9
criterion.validity: applies only if C converged within the cap and rule ten (terminal step / tolerance) < 1; otherwise INDETERMINATE

hypothesis: H-epsilon: EPS_ESSO_THROUGHPUT acts as a throughput price at the ADMM fixed point (transmitted to the networks by the consensus dual), suppressing storage cycling.
not_permitted: changing the criterion after the result is seen
tuning tol, rho, cap or budget in the arm
